job.title: R studio project
job.description:
Research paper:
Imagine you have been working as a portfolio analyst at RSG Bank Mexico for the past two years. On the first business day of 2023, you are notified that you will be promoted to Portfolio Manager of a new division focused on NYSE and NASDAQ stocks. You have to design 3 portfolios based on US stocks. You will have 5 weeks to design your portfolios because after this period the marketing department will launch advertising for your 3 financial products:

10-N&N mix C
10-N&N mix A
10-N&N mix D
Each one will target a different risk profile: conservative, aggressive and disruptive. The challenge is to make the portfolios attractive for each profile in order to increase the income of the new investment division of RSG Bank México. The potential clients of the financial products that you will design will be both companies and individuals who usually invest in the Mexican Stock Market and are looking for an alternative to invest in the US market.

Solution Report

You have to use RStudio to produce the delivery document of your Evidence. It must have the following sections:

Introduction: contextualization of the problem situation in which you find yourself
Preliminary selection of assets based on a logistic regression model
Definitive selection of assets based on the “market model”
Portfolio modeling and optimization
Conclusion
Bibliography
 

The document that you must deliver is in the nature of a work report. It is not an executive report for managers (does not have to be too short). It's not an investment plan for a client (it doesn't have to be too simple). It is not a repository of notes and solved exercises (it does not have to be too informal). It is a report for your immediate boss that can be shared with your co-workers so that it serves as a basis for training other financial analysts. Your report should be able to teach others to answer the following questions:

 

1. How do I create financial products for different risk profiles from stock investment portfolios?
2. What modeling, programming and analysis should I do to be able to present a portfolio investment proposal to a client?
 

In your report you can be technical but without sacrificing clarity. You can be detailed but without neglecting the extension of pages. You can present your results however you like but without sacrificing the structure and logic of the steps. Be consistent with the models, concepts and theories that we study in the course to arrive at your results and interpretations.

RUBRIC
• Requirements Weight in the rating
Contextualization of the problem situation: Describe the context of the problem situation that you intend to solve
• Phase 1: Preliminary Selection of Assets:
Explain the steps you followed to define your variables, both the dependent and the independent. It considers financial variables and financial ratios (variables defined from divisions). If your variables are defined by divisions, avoid dividing by 0 and winsorize where appropriate. If your variables are not defined by divisions, if your distribution requires it, get the logarithms of those variables, avoid getting logarithms of 0 and negative values, and winsorize where relevant.
Give theoretical and/or practical justifications for your selection of independent variables.
Generate a preliminary list of actions from the predicted probabilities of your Logit model.
• Phase 2: Definitive Selection of Assets
Run the market model for each of the stocks in your preliminary selection. Calculate return above or below market return and market risk for each stock. All these calculations must be highly automated, relying on loops.
It presents key data for each model: b0, b1, standard errors, and p-values for each coefficient.
Code 3 different criteria for you to do 3 subsets of 10 actions from your preliminary section. These subsets should be a conservative, an aggressive, and a disruptive portfolio.
Make a full argument about why your subsets have a “conservative”, “aggressive” and “disruptive” character respectively.
• Phase 3: Portfolio Optimization
For each subset calculate:

The expected return of each stock in the subset
The variance-covariance matrix
The correlation matrix

job.description:
Job Title : Snowflake Developer
Experience : 4+ years
Budget: 80k – 90k Per Month
8hours/day 5days/week
Remote Working
monthly payment 

Job Purpose:

The successful candidate will closely work with the team from one of our esteemed client from UK, they are into global travel and event management arena with extraordinary service and proprietary, client-led technology.

This is really an amazing opportunity for those, who have a passion for data engineering and operations, looking forward to take up challenging work and explore nuances of newer tech stack. You will work within a modern data stack of Fivetran, DBT, and Snowflake in order to build and maintain a first-class data warehouse.

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a high growth environment. You combine strategic thinking with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get the job done. You care just as much about efficiency as you do quality in execution. You’re collaborative, flexible, open-minded and have a passion for the role that technology plays in driving extraordinary service.

Responsibilities:

Working closely with the data engineering and BI teams, design and develop our data warehouse model to create rich, usable data stores
Identify and implement tests and monitoring to ensure data quality and reliability
Create the definitions and metrics for a “single source of truth” to fuel all company decision making
Promote knowledge sharing and ensure that documentation is captured and updated regularly in line with implemented changes.
Define best practices in data models and development. Coach our analysts and data scientists on how to be effective data modelers
Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders and leadership
Continuously find ways to expose more value in our raw data and lower the amount of effort our end users spend on getting answers
Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

4+ years of work experience in data engineering/data warehousing
2+ years of experience building and maintaining high scale ELT
Proficiency in DBT is an absolute must
Experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)
Highly proficient in SQL (Python desirable but not required)
Well versed with data modelling (any methodology) and implementation
Worked in Agile/Scrum lifecycle
Demonstrated experience working in/with BI teams to surface metrics
Strong communication and exceptional team player with effective problem-solving skills
